item.title: Rust Officially Sets Rules for AI Coding: LLM-Written PRs Must Ship Tests, Merges Circuit-Break at 50%
item.description: On August 5, 2026, five Rust teams adopted an LLM usage policy for rust-lang/rust: AI-created code can land in the compiler, but only with disclosure, mandatory tests, and a ban on soundness-critical paths — and if LLM PRs exceed 50% of merges in any 6-week window, a circuit breaker halts them. Full policy breakdown and community debate inside
